definition_zh: 保守主义；抗拒变化的性情；财政保守主义；社会文化保守主义；宗教保守主义；制度守成；传统主义一支；贬义的僵化
definition_en: a preference for what already exists, turned into a political doctrine, a budget rule, a cultural stance or a habit of mind
core_image: 一间老屋被人小心修补，瓦片换成同样的旧款，门轴只加油而不拆门，屋里的人说「先别动它」
scene: 老宅要翻修，工匠提议换掉整排窗框，屋主只让他补上开裂的那一块，其余原样保留。Fiscal conservatism keeps the budget balanced even when the economy slows.
sceneCN: 老宅翻修时，工匠提议换掉整排窗框，屋主只让补上开裂的那一块，其余原样保留；句中的词指「财政上的保守主张」（第 3 个义项：主张低税、平衡预算、审慎支出、不轻易借债的财政立场）。图中可辨识物件：旧窗框、裂缝、油壶、账本、铅笔划出的预算线。

pos.zh: 保守主义（不可数，指思想传统）
保守的倾向或做法（可数，指某一具体主张）

collocations.zh: 保守主义对骤变改革的不信任

senses.title: The doctrine of continuity
senses.titleCN: 以延续为要的政治学说
senses.definition: a political doctrine that trusts inherited institutions, prefers gradual repair to wholesale redesign, and warns against abstract plans
senses.definitionCN: 信任继承下来的制度、偏好渐进修补而非整体重画、并警惕抽象蓝图的政治学说
senses.example: Conservatism asks what a reform will destroy before it asks what it will build.
senses.exampleCN: 保守主义先问一项改革会毁掉什么，再问它会建成什么。
senses.why: The Latin verb behind the word means to keep and to guard; the doctrine makes that act of guarding the state's main virtue.
senses.whyCN: 这个词背后的拉丁动词意为保住、看守；这套学说把「看守」这个动作当作国家的首要德性。

senses.title: The temperament: slow by instinct
senses.titleCN: 性情层面：本能地慢
senses.definition: a personal habit of disliking novelty, preferring familiar routines and resisting any change not forced on one
senses.definitionCN: 不喜欢新奇、偏好熟悉的常规、抗拒并非被迫的变动的那种个人习惯
senses.example: His conservatism was personal, not political: same chair, same route, same lunch.
senses.exampleCN: 他的保守是性情上的，不是政治上的：同一把椅子、同一条路、同一份午餐。
senses.why: Before it was a party label, the word described a temper: a mind that keeps what it already has.
senses.whyCN: 在成为党派标签之前，这个词描述的是一种脾气：守住已有之物的心智。

senses.title: The budget rule: spend only what you have
senses.titleCN: 预算规则：只花手里有的钱
senses.definition: the stance that prefers low taxes, balanced budgets and cautious spending to stimulus and borrowing
senses.definitionCN: 偏好低税、平衡预算与审慎支出、而非刺激与借债的立场
senses.example: Fiscal conservatism blocked the loan before the vote was taken.
senses.exampleCN: 财政保守主义在表决之前就拦下了这笔借款。
senses.why: A household that guards its savings supplies a model for a treasury: keep a reserve, distrust the promise of future growth.
senses.whyCN: 守住积蓄的家庭为国库提供了样板：留出储备，不轻信未来增长的许诺。

senses.title: The cultural stance: inherited order
senses.titleCN: 文化立场：继承下来的秩序
senses.definition: the view that family, custom, religion and local loyalty carry knowledge that no reformer can fully replace
senses.definitionCN: 认为家庭、习俗、宗教与乡土忠诚承载着改革者无法完全替代的知识
senses.example: Social conservatism defended the village school against a merger it called rootless.
senses.exampleCN: 社会保守主义维护村校，反对它称之为「无根」的合并。
senses.why: If institutions store accumulated experience, tearing one down discards knowledge that cannot be written on a planner's sheet.
senses.whyCN: 如果制度储存着积累的经验，拆掉其中一个就丢弃了写不进计划表的知识。

senses.title: The religious stance: the old creed intact
senses.titleCN: 宗教立场：保持古老信条的完整
senses.definition: the movement that defends traditional doctrine, liturgy and authority against reinterpretation
senses.definitionCN: 维护传统教义、礼仪与权威、反对重新解释的运动
senses.example: Religious conservatism resisted the new prayer book and kept the old one in use.
senses.exampleCN: 宗教保守主义抵制新祈祷书，继续使用旧的那本。
senses.why: A revealed text is treated as a trust to be handed on unchanged, so revision feels like loss rather than learning.
senses.whyCN: 被启示的文本被视为原样传交的托管物，因此改写更像是损失而不是长进。

senses.title: The institutional habit: keep the procedure
senses.titleCN: 制度习惯：守住程序
senses.definition: the tendency of a court, a university or a civil service to protect its own routines, records and precedents
senses.definitionCN: 法院、大学或公务员系统维护自身惯例、档案与先例的倾向
senses.example: Institutional conservatism saved the archive when the ministry wanted to digitize and discard it.
senses.exampleCN: 部里想数字化后丢弃档案时，制度守成保住了那批档案。
senses.why: An institution is a machine for remembering; its conservatism is the memory defending itself.
senses.whyCN: 机构是一台记忆机器；它的守成就是记忆在保卫自己。

senses.title: The traditionalist wing: further back
senses.titleCN: 传统主义一支：退得更远
senses.definition: the strand that wants to restore an earlier moral and social order rather than merely slow the present one
senses.definitionCN: 主张恢复更早的道德与社会秩序、而不只是放慢当下变化的那一支
senses.example: The traditionalist wing of conservatism idealised a village life it had never known.
senses.exampleCN: 保守主义中的传统主义一支，把一种自己从未经历过的乡村生活理想化。
senses.why: Guardianship can look backward as well as sideways: if the good order is old, keeping it may mean recovering it.
senses.whyCN: 看守既可能向旁边看，也可能向后看：如果良好秩序是旧的，守住它就可能意味着把它找回来。

senses.title: The sneer: obstinate, backward
senses.titleCN: 贬义：顽固、落后
senses.definition: a hostile use naming any refusal to face facts, especially in someone else's politics
senses.definitionCN: 带敌意的用法，指任何不愿面对事实的拒绝，尤用于别人的政治立场
senses.example: They called her conservatism a fear of the future and left it at that.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把她那套保守主张说成对未来的恐惧，就此打住。
senses.why: The same word that praises steadiness can be turned to mean stiffness; the sneer keeps the outline and removes the praise.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词既赞美稳重，也能被扭成僵硬；讥讽保留轮廓，抽走赞美。

intro.en: The chain runs from Latin servare 'to keep, to guard' through conservare 'to keep safe' to the English adjective, and only then to the political noun of the nineteenth century.
intro.cn: 这条链从拉丁语中意为「看守、保存」的动词，经「保住」的复合动词，到英语的形容词，再到十九世纪才出现的政治名词。

items.en: Servare meant to watch over, to keep and to preserve; it is the root of preserve, reserve, observe and conserve, and it carries no political colour at all.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为看守、保存、保全；它是保存、保留、观察与保护等英语词的词根，本身全然不带政治色彩。

items.en: Con-, here intensive, plus servare made conservare 'to keep safe, to maintain intact'; the compound stresses how complete the keeping is.
items.cn: 表示加强语气的共同前缀加「看守」，构成「保住、维持完整」的拉丁动词；这个复合词强调守住之彻底。

items.en: A conservator was one who kept or guarded something, including a guardian appointed by law; English still uses the word for a keeper of collections.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指看守、保全某物的人，也包括法律指定的监护人；英语至今用它指藏品维护者。

items.en: French politics around 1818 used conservateur for the defenders of the restored order, and the label travelled to Britain as a name for a political side.
items.cn: 约在一八一八年，法国政治用这个词指复辟秩序的维护者，这个标签随后传到英国，成为一个政治阵营的名称。

items.en: Conservative entered English as an adjective meaning preservative or tending to keep, well before it named a party; a conservative estimate was already a cautious one.
items.cn: 这个形容词进入英语时意为「有保存作用的、倾向于守住的」，远早于它指称党派；保守的估计当时已指谨慎的估计。

items.en: The noun conservatism appeared in the eighteen-thirties as the name of a doctrine, formed by adding the doctrine suffix to the adjective; later it widened to budgets, culture, religion and institutions.
items.cn: 这个名词在十九世纪三十年代出现，作为一个学说的名称，由形容词加表示主张的后缀构成；后来扩展到预算、文化、宗教与制度。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin verb at the root but has split into different jobs; the second group names positions that are often confused with the headword.
note.cn: 第一组同出那个拉丁动词，但已分工为不同的词；第二组是常与词条混淆的立场名称。

entries.definition: The act of protecting objects, wildlife or resources from loss; it names the work, not a political doctrine, and it never describes a person.
entries.definitionCN: 指保护物件、野生生物或资源不致损失的行为；它指这项工作，不是政治学说，也从不形容人。

entries.definition: A building where plants are kept, or a school of music; the keeping is literal and physical, with no politics in it.
entries.definitionCN: 指养植物的玻璃房，或一所音乐学校；这里的「保存」是字面而具体的，毫无政治含义。

entries.definition: The adjective and its noun for a person or a party member; the headword names the doctrine those people hold.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，也可作名词指人或党派成员；词条指这些人所持的学说。

entries.definition: A person who repairs and cares for objects or collections; it is a job title, not a political label.
entries.definitionCN: 指修复并照料物件或藏品的人；它是职业名称，不是政治标签。

entries.definition: A belief that old ways carry authority in themselves; conservatism may borrow that argument, but it also accepts piecemeal reform.
entries.definitionCN: 相信旧做法本身即具权威；保守主义可能借用这一论证，但也接受零敲碎打的改良。

entries.definition: A desire to undo changes and return to an earlier order; conservatism usually wants to keep the present, not reverse it.
entries.definitionCN: 主张取消已发生的变化、回到更早的秩序；保守主义通常想保住当下，而非倒回去。

entries.definition: The tradition of a particular British party, with its own history, instincts and internal quarrels; it is one home for the doctrine, not the doctrine itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指英国某一政党的传统，有其自身历史、直觉与内部分歧；它是这套学说的一个归宿，而非学说本身。

entries.definition: The method of changing things in small steps; a reformer of any colour can use it, so it names a pace rather than a side.
entries.definitionCN: 以小步改变事物的方法；任何颜色的改革者都能采用，因此它指速度，而非阵营。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, the real derived words and the real budget phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的派生词与真实的预算说法。

normal.en: The prefix means 'thoroughly' and the root means 'keep': to keep something safe all round.
normal.cn: 前缀表示「彻底」，词根表示「看守」：把某物整个护住。

normal.en: The family runs conserve, conservation, conservative, conservator and conservancy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括保护、保存、保守的、修复者与保护区机构。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the budget sense: fiscal conservatism, balanced budgets, cautious spending.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出预算义：财政保守主义、平衡预算、审慎支出。

normal.en: The same root appears in preserve, reserve and observe, all through the Latin verb for keeping watch.
normal.cn: 同一词根出现在保存、保留与观察三词里，都经那个意为看守的拉丁动词。

normal.en: History anchor: the label reached Britain from French politics after the restored order, and then named a party.
normal.cn: 历史锚点：这个标签在复辟秩序之后从法国政治传到英国，随后成为一个党派的名称。

abstract.en: An old roof is patched with tiles of the same old shape, never replaced wholesale.
abstract.cn: 旧屋顶只用同样旧款的瓦来补，从不整片换掉。

abstract.en: A key is oiled rather than exchanged: the lock still turns, so why change it.
abstract.cn: 钥匙孔只上油、不换锁：锁还能转，何必换。

abstract.en: A ledger with a reserve line left blank on purpose, so the year cannot end in debt.
abstract.cn: 一本账上特意留出一行储备，好让这一年不至于以欠债收场。

examples.en: Conservatism prefers a repaired institution to a brilliant new plan.
examples.cn: 保守主义宁可要修好的旧制度，也不要漂亮的新方案。

examples.en: Fiscal conservatism made the treasury refuse the loan.
examples.cn: 财政保守主义让国库拒绝了那笔借款。

examples.en: The book treats conservatism as a temper before it treats it as a party.
examples.cn: 这本书先把它当作一种性情，再当作一个党派。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯色维提泽姆」——谐音「肯守」：肯守住老规矩、不肯轻易换 → 保守主义

root: 拉丁 conservare「保住、维持完整」= con-（加强）+ servare「看守、保存」；servare 更深来源一般追溯到原始印欧语中表示「看守、保护」的重构词根。英语中由形容词加表示主张的名词后缀构成，与表示「保护、保存」的同源名词语义分工不同。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one act of guarding: a doctrine of continuity, a slow temper, a budget rule, a cultural order, an old creed, an institutional routine, a look further back, and finally a sneer.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个「看守」的动作展开：以延续为要的学说、缓慢的性情、预算规则、文化秩序、古老信条、机构惯例、向更远处回望，最后是一句讥讽。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand keeping a worn object in place while others reach for a replacement.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把磨损的物件按在原处，别人正伸手去拿替代品。

branches.en: DOCTRINE AND CREED: the general theory of continuity, and its religious form, where the text itself is the thing guarded.
branches.cn: 学说与信条：关于延续的一般理论，及其宗教形态——在那里被守住的是文本本身。

branches.en: TEMPER AND ROUTINE: a person's dislike of novelty, and an institution's protection of its own procedure.
branches.cn: 性情与惯例：个人对新奇的不喜，以及机构对自身程序的维护。

branches.en: MONEY AND MEMORY: the budget rule that hoards reserves, and the wing that wants an earlier order restored.
branches.cn: 钱袋与记忆：囤住储备的预算规则，以及主张恢复更早秩序的那一支。

branches.en: CULTURE: family, custom and local loyalty treated as stored knowledge.
branches.cn: 文化：把家庭、习俗与乡土忠诚当作储存起来的知识。

branches.en: SNEAR: the same word used to mean mere stiffness.
branches.cn: 讥讽：同一个词被用来指单纯的僵硬。

intro.en: The word is one Latin prefix, one Latin verb and two suffixes, and every piece also builds other English words in common use.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个拉丁动词与两个后缀构成，每一部分还能构成别的常用英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare 'to keep watch' supplies the root, con- adds thoroughness, -ative makes the adjective of tendency and -ism makes the name of the doctrine.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词「看守」提供词根，表示共同与彻底的前缀加强语气，表示倾向的形容词后缀构成形容词，表示主张的名词后缀构成学说名称。

items.meaningCN: 表示「共同、彻底」的前缀
items.example: The prefix binds the act of guarding into one whole.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把「看守」的动作收束成一个整体。

items.meaningCN: 表示「看守、保存」的词根
items.example: The root carries the idea of standing watch.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根带着「站岗看守」的意思。

items.meaningCN: 表示「倾向于……」的形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix turns a verb of keeping into a quality of mind.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「守住」的动词变成一种心智倾向。

items.meaningCN: 表示「体系、主张」的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix turns the adjective into the name of a school.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成学派名称。

items.meaningCN: 使免于损失；保存
items.example: Volunteers conserve the old maps in a dry room.
items.exampleCN: 志愿者把旧地图保存在干燥的房间里。

items.meaningCN: 保存（动作或结果）
items.example: Soil conservation slowed the erosion.
items.exampleCN: 土壤保护减缓了侵蚀。

items.meaning: tending to keep things as they are
items.meaningCN: 倾向维持原状的；保守的
items.example: She gave a conservative estimate of the cost.
items.exampleCN: 她对成本作了保守的估计。

items.meaningCN: 主张守住的学说
items.example: Conservatism distrusts plans that ignore what exists.
items.exampleCN: 这套学说怀疑忽视既有事物的方案。

items.meaning: a person who repairs and maintains objects
items.meaningCN: 修复并维护物件的人
items.example: The conservator cleaned the painting layer by layer.
items.exampleCN: 修复师一层层地清理这幅画。

items.meaning: a body or area that manages protection
items.meaningCN: 保护管理机构或保护区
items.example: The river conservancy patrols the banks.
items.exampleCN: 河流保护机构巡护两岸。

definition_zh: 保守的；反对骤变的；政治右倾的；谨慎的（估计）；传统守旧的；保守派支持者；谨慎的人；保守估计；保守治疗
definition_en: preferring things as they are and resisting sudden change, or deliberately cautious in estimates and treatment
core_image: 一个人站在门口不肯换掉旧锁，只肯给锁芯上油；他说新的未必更好，坏的还能修
scene: 装修队建议把整扇门连框换掉，屋主摸了摸门轴，只让工人上油，说这扇门还能用很久。Her estimate was deliberately conservative so that the project would not run short.
sceneCN: 装修队建议把整扇门连框换掉，屋主摸了摸门轴，只让工人上油，说这扇门还能用很久；句中的词指「谨慎、留有余地的估计」（第 3 个义项：在数字与预测上故意压低或求稳，使结果不至于令人失望）。图中可辨识物件：旧门轴、油壶、拆下的新门框、记着数字的便签。

pos.zh: 保守的；反对骤变的；政治右倾的
谨慎的；留有余地的（估计、预测）
保守派支持者；谨慎的人

senses.title: Unwilling to risk a sudden break
senses.titleCN: 不愿冒骤变之险
senses.definition: preferring existing arrangements and changing them only slowly, in small steps, with room to retreat
senses.definitionCN: 偏好现有安排，只以小步、缓慢、可回退的方式改变它们
senses.example: The board took a conservative route: repair the old system before replacing it.
senses.exampleCN: 董事会选了保守的路线：先修旧系统，再谈替换。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to keep safe; a conservative choice is one that keeps what already works from being lost.
senses.whyCN: 那个拉丁动词意为保住；保守的选择就是把已经管用的东西不丢掉的选择。

senses.title: The political label: right of centre
senses.titleCN: 政治标签：偏右的立场
senses.definition: belonging to, voting for, or favouring the side that defends markets, tradition and order against rapid redistribution
senses.definitionCN: 属于、投票给或倾向那一方的：维护市场、传统与秩序，反对快速再分配
senses.example: A conservative member opposed the bill while a liberal one defended it.
senses.exampleCN: 一名保守派议员反对该法案，一名自由派议员则为它辩护。
senses.why: A party took the adjective as a name, and the name then spread to everyone who votes that way, whatever their personal temper.
senses.whyCN: 一个政党把这个形容词拿去当名字，这个名字随后扩散到所有这样投票的人，不论其个人脾气如何。

senses.title: The cautious number
senses.titleCN: 谨慎的数字
senses.definition: deliberately low or safe in an estimate, forecast or figure, so that the result should not disappoint
senses.definitionCN: 在估计、预测或数字上故意压低或求稳，使结果不至于令人失望
senses.example: Planners used a conservative figure for ticket sales.
senses.exampleCN: 规划者对售票量用了保守的数字。
senses.why: Guarding applies to numbers too: a figure that leaves margin is a figure that cannot badly fail.
senses.whyCN: 看守也适用于数字：留有余地的数字，是不会惨败的数字。

senses.title: The old-fashioned taste
senses.titleCN: 守旧的品味
senses.definition: plain, formal or traditional in dress, furniture and manners, avoiding what is new or showy
senses.definitionCN: 衣着、家具与举止上朴素、正式或传统，避开新奇与张扬
senses.example: He wore a conservative suit and refused the bright tie his son gave him.
senses.exampleCN: 他穿一身守旧的西装，拒绝儿子送的那条亮色领带。
senses.why: Keeping a style is a small daily version of keeping an order: what was good enough last year is still good enough.
senses.whyCN: 守住一种样式，是守住一种秩序在日常里的小版本：去年够好的，今年仍然够好。

senses.title: A supporter of the right
senses.titleCN: 右翼阵营的支持者
senses.definition: a person who votes for or belongs to the conservative side in politics
senses.definitionCN: 在政治上投票给或属于保守一方的人
senses.example: The conservatives lost the seat by a few hundred votes.
senses.exampleCN: 保守派以几百票之差丢掉了那个议席。
senses.why: Adjectives become nouns when the quality is worn as an identity; the capital letter turns it into a party member.
senses.whyCN: 当某种性质被当作身份穿在身上，形容词就变成名词；大写首字母则使它成为政党成员。

senses.title: A careful person, in ordinary speech
senses.titleCN: 日常口语里的谨慎之人
senses.definition: someone who dislikes risk and prefers the familiar way of doing things
senses.definitionCN: 不喜欢风险、偏好熟悉做法的人
senses.example: My father is a conservative about money and a spendthrift about books.
senses.exampleCN: 我父亲在钱上是保守派，在书上却大手大脚。
senses.why: The same temper described as an adjective can stand alone as a person: one who keeps to the tried path.
senses.whyCN: 用形容词描述的那种脾气也能单独指人：一个走老路的人。

senses.title: The cautious test
senses.titleCN: 统计上的保守检验
senses.definition: in statistics, a test or interval deliberately built to reduce the chance of a false positive, even at the cost of missing a real effect
senses.definitionCN: 统计学中故意设计成降低误报概率的检验或区间，代价是可能漏掉真实效应
senses.example: The team chose a conservative test that would not exaggerate the treatment effect.
senses.exampleCN: 团队选择了一种不会夸大治疗效果的保守检验。
senses.why: Caution here is a design choice: the procedure is tuned to understate rather than overstate a finding.
senses.whyCN: 这里的谨慎是一种设计选择：这套程序被调成宁可低估也不高估结果。

senses.title: Treatment without surgery
senses.titleCN: 不动手术的保守治疗
senses.definition: medical care that relies on rest, drugs and observation rather than an operation
senses.definitionCN: 依靠休息、药物与观察、而非手术的医疗处置
senses.example: Doctors chose conservative treatment and watched the knee for six weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 医生选择保守治疗，观察膝盖六周。
senses.why: In medicine the word keeps its oldest promise: keep the body safe and avoid the irreversible cut if time can do the work.
senses.whyCN: 在医学里，这个词守着最老的承诺：保住身体，若时间能起作用就不做不可逆的一刀。

intro.en: The adjective came first, meaning 'tending to keep'; the political noun followed in the nineteenth century, and the medical phrase came later still. The Latin verb at the root is the same one behind conservation.
intro.cn: 先有形容词，意为「倾向于守住的」；政治上的名词用法在十九世纪才跟上，医学说法更晚。词根的拉丁动词与「保护」一词所由来的动词相同。

items.en: Servare 'to keep, to guard' is the root of a large family: preserve, reserve, observe, conserve and servitude all draw on it.
items.cn: 意为「看守、保存」的拉丁动词是一个大词族的根：保存、保留、观察、保护与奴役等词都取自它。

items.en: Con- plus servare made conservare 'to keep safe'; its participle conservatus is the base of the English adjective.
items.cn: 共同前缀加「看守」构成「保住」的拉丁动词；其分词是英语形容词的基础。

items.en: French supplied the adjective form in the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries, meaning preservative, with the sense of a tendency rather than a party.
items.cn: 法语在中世纪晚期提供了这个形容词形式，意为「有保存作用的」，表示一种倾向，而非一个党派。

items.en: English used the adjective for medicines, estimates and habits long before politics: a conservative dose was a small safe one.
items.cn: 英语很早就在药物、估计与习惯上使用这个形容词，远早于政治：保守的剂量就是小而安全的一剂。

items.en: In the eighteen-thirties the adjective was capitalized as a party name in Britain, and the noun for a member followed at once.
items.cn: 到十九世纪三十年代，这个形容词在英国被大写成一个党名，指成员的相应名词随即出现。

items.en: Conservative treatment entered clinical speech in the twentieth century, naming care that avoids an operation.
items.cn: 保守治疗这一说法在二十世纪进入临床语言，指避免手术的处置方式。

note.en: The first group grows from one Latin verb and is easily confused; the second group holds words that are close in sense but not synonyms.
note.cn: 第一组都从同一个拉丁动词长出，极易混淆；第二组是意思接近但并非同义的词。

entries.definition: The protection of objects, wildlife or resources; a noun of activity. A conservative person may support it, but the words are not interchangeable.
entries.definitionCN: 指对物件、野生生物或资源的保护，是表示活动的名词。保守的人可能支持它，但两词不能互换。

entries.definition: A glass building for plants or a music school; here keeping is literal and physical, with no political sense at all.
entries.definitionCN: 指养植物的玻璃房或音乐学校；这里的「保存」是字面而具体的，毫无政治含义。

entries.definition: The name of the doctrine, not of a person or a single policy; the adjective describes, the doctrine noun names a tradition.
entries.definitionCN: 那是学说名称，不是指人或某项政策；形容词用来描述，学说名词指一个传统。

entries.definition: A keeper and repairer of collections; it is an occupation, and the freedom it protects is the object's, not the citizen's.
entries.definitionCN: 指藏品的维护与修复者；它是一种职业，所保护的是物件而非公民的自由。

entries.definition: Careful to avoid danger or error; it says nothing about ideology and is the plain word for a careful estimate.
entries.definitionCN: 指小心避开危险或错误；它不涉及意识形态，是形容谨慎估计的普通词。

entries.definition: Following patterns handed down from the past; a traditional dish or dance need not imply any political stance.
entries.definitionCN: 指沿袭过去传下的样式；一道传统菜或一支传统舞并不含政治立场。

entries.definition: A position on the political spectrum, stated bluntly; it is more openly partisan than the headword and less tied to caution.
entries.definitionCN: 直白地指政治光谱上的位置；它比词条更带党派色彩，也与「谨慎」无关。

entries.definition: Holding views that are not extreme; a moderate reformer wants a small change, while a conservative may want no change at all.
entries.definitionCN: 指观点不极端；温和的改革者想要小幅改变，而保守者可能一步也不想动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin verb, the real inflections and the real phrases about estimates and treatment.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁动词、真实的变形，以及关于估计与治疗的真实说法。

normal.en: The prefix means 'thoroughly' and the root means 'keep': a conservative choice keeps what already works.
normal.cn: 前缀表示「彻底」，词根表示「看守」：保守的选择就是把已经管用的东西守住。

normal.en: The family runs conserve, conservation, conservatism, conservator and conservancy.
normal.cn: 同族词包括保护、保存、保守主义、修复者与保护区机构。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the cautious sense: a conservative estimate, a conservative figure, conservative treatment.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出谨慎义：保守的估计、保守的数字、保守治疗。

normal.en: The same root sits in preserve and reserve, which are also about keeping something back.
normal.cn: 同一词根还在保存与保留两词里，它们同样指把某物留住。

normal.en: Grammar anchor: the comparative and superlative take a degree word in front, and the adverb takes a suffix.
normal.cn: 语法锚点：比较级与最高级都在前面加程度词，副词则加后缀。

abstract.en: A hand resting on a door handle, unwilling to exchange the lock for a new one.
abstract.cn: 一只手按在门把上，不愿把旧锁换成新的。

abstract.en: A pencil writes a low number and then leaves a margin beside it.
abstract.cn: 铅笔写下一个偏低的数字，然后在旁边留出空白。

abstract.en: A doctor waits six weeks before deciding on the knife.
abstract.cn: 医生先等六周，再决定要不要动刀。

examples.en: She gave a conservative estimate so the budget would hold.
examples.cn: 她给了保守的估计，好让预算撑得住。

examples.en: The party drew conservative voters from the surrounding towns.
examples.cn: 该党从周边城镇吸引了保守派选民。

examples.en: The surgeon preferred conservative treatment for the torn ligament.
examples.cn: 外科医生对撕裂的韧带倾向于保守治疗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肯色维提夫」——谐音「肯守」：肯守着旧样子、不轻易动 → 保守的

root: 拉丁 conservare「保住、维持完整」的过去分词 conservatus + 形容词后缀 -ive；con- 表加强，servare 表「看守、保存」，servare 更深来源一般追溯到原始印欧语中表示「看守、保护」的重构词根。同源词包括表示「保护、保存」的名词、表示「看守者」的名词与表示「保护区」的名词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses split into four adjectives and four nouns: a stance against sudden change, a political side, a cautious number, an old-fashioned taste, then the supporter, the careful person, the safe figure and the treatment that avoids surgery.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项分成四个形容词与四个名词：反对骤变的立场、政治上的阵营、谨慎的数字、守旧的品味，然后是支持者、谨慎的人、那个稳妥数字，以及不动手术的处置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: keep the old thing working rather than swap it for a new one.
core.cn: 核心意象：让旧东西继续管用，而不是换成新的。

branches.en: STANCE AND ITS BEARER: the dislike of a sudden break, and the person who votes for the side that shares it.
branches.cn: 立场与承载者：不喜欢骤变，以及投票给持同一立场那一方的人。

branches.en: LABEL AND TEMPER: a party name, and the ordinary careful person who merely likes the tried path.
branches.cn: 标签与脾气：一个党派名称，以及只喜欢走老路的日常谨慎之人。

branches.en: THE SAFE NUMBER AND THE SAFE TEST: a deliberately low figure and a procedure tuned not to overstate an effect.
branches.cn: 稳妥的数字与稳妥的检验：一个故意压低的工作数字，和一套宁可低估效应的程序。

branches.en: TASTE: plain, formal dress and furniture, where keeping a style keeps an order.
branches.cn: 品味：朴素正式的衣着与家具；守住样式就是守住秩序。

branches.en: MEDICINE: care that waits and watches instead of cutting.
branches.cn: 医学：先等待观察、不动刀的处置。

intro.en: One Latin prefix, one Latin verb, an adjective suffix and a doctrine suffix lie behind this word, and each part also builds common English words.
intro.cn: 这个词背后有一个拉丁前缀、一个拉丁动词、一个形容词后缀与一个表示主张的后缀，每一部分还能构成常用英语词。

latinIntro.en: Servare gives the root, con- adds force, and -ative marks a tendency; the same three pieces build conserve, conservation and conservative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词「看守」提供词根，共同前缀加强语气，表示倾向的后缀标出倾向；同样的三块构件构成保护、保存与保守的。

items.meaningCN: 表示「共同、彻底」的前缀
items.example: The prefix makes the guarding complete.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀让「看守」变得彻底。

items.meaningCN: 表示「看守、保存」的词根
items.example: The root images a guard standing at a gate.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根画出卫兵守在门口的画面。

items.meaningCN: 表示「倾向于……」的形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix turns keeping into a habit of mind.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「守住」变成一种心智习惯。

items.meaningCN: 使免于损失；保存
items.example: They conserve the old ledgers in a dry room.
items.exampleCN: 他们把旧账册保存在干燥的房间里。

items.meaningCN: 保存（动作或结果）
items.example: Water conservation began with repaired pipes.
items.exampleCN: 节水从修补管道开始。

items.meaning: tending to keep things as they are
items.meaningCN: 倾向维持原状的；保守的
items.example: He gave a conservative estimate.
items.exampleCN: 他给了一个保守的估计。

items.meaningCN: 主张守住的学说
items.example: Conservatism distrusts sudden redesign.
items.exampleCN: 这套学说怀疑骤然重画。

items.meaning: a place where plants are kept
items.meaningCN: 养护植物的场所
items.example: The conservatory kept the seedlings alive through winter.
items.exampleCN: 温室让幼苗熬过了冬天。

items.meaning: a keeper and repairer of objects
items.meaningCN: 维护与修复物件的人
items.example: The conservator treated the brittle paper.
items.exampleCN: 修复师处理了那叠脆纸。

items.meaningCN: 保护管理机构
items.example: The conservancy manages the wetland.
items.exampleCN: 该机构管理这片湿地。

definition_zh: 社会主义；以公共所有为主的经济制度；社会主义运动；国家社会主义；民主社会主义；空想社会主义；科学社会主义；社会民主主义；贬义的松散用法
definition_en: a set of systems and movements that would put the main means of production under collective or public control
core_image: 一座工厂大门上原本写着股东名字的铜牌被卸下，换上一行字：归大家所有
scene: 旧厂房的铜牌被撬下来，新挂上的牌子写着由国家接管，工人们站在门口读那张公告。State socialism put the steel mills and the railways under public ownership.
sceneCN: 旧厂房的铜牌被撬下来，新挂上的牌子写着由国家接管，工人们站在门口读那张公告；句中的词指「国家社会主义」（第 3 个义项：由国家拥有并经营主要产业、通过部委而非市场来计划产出的版本）。

pos.zh: 社会主义（不可数，指制度或思想体系）
社会主义的一种流派或实践（可数）

forms.label: 名词（同族：社会民主主义）

derivatives.zh: 社会主义者；社会主义的

senses.title: Collective ownership of production
senses.titleCN: 生产资料的集体所有
senses.definition: an economic order in which factories, land and transport belong to the community or the state rather than to private owners
senses.definitionCN: 工厂、土地与运输归社区或国家所有、而不归私人所有者的经济秩序
senses.example: Under socialism the mill's profits went to the town rather than to a single family.
senses.exampleCN: 在这种制度下，工厂的利润归全镇，而不归某一家人。
senses.why: The Latin noun at the root means 'companion'; the doctrine begins by making the companions joint owners of what they use together.
senses.whyCN: 词根的拉丁名词意为「同伴」；这套主张的起点是让同伴们共同拥有他们一起使用的东西。

senses.title: The movement that fights for it
senses.titleCN: 为之奋斗的运动
senses.definition: the organised political activity of parties, unions and campaigns that seek such ownership
senses.definitionCN: 政党、工会与运动所组织的、争取这种所有制的政治活动
senses.example: Socialism in that decade meant meetings, pamphlets and strikes more than legislation.
senses.exampleCN: 在那个十年里，它更多意味着集会、小册子与罢工，而不是立法。
senses.why: A system has to be argued for before it can be built, so the word also names the arguing: meetings, papers and organised pressure.
senses.whyCN: 制度在被建成之前必须先被论证，因此这个词也指那场论证：会议、文字与有组织的压力。

senses.title: The state as the owner
senses.titleCN: 国家充当所有者
senses.definition: a version in which the state owns and runs the main industries, planning output through ministries rather than markets
senses.definitionCN: 由国家拥有并经营主要产业、通过部委而非市场来计划产出的版本
senses.example: State socialism nationalised the mines and set output in a five-year plan.
senses.exampleCN: 国家社会主义把矿山收归国有，并用五年计划规定产量。
senses.why: If the community is to own, someone must hold the deed; the state is the largest available body to do the holding.
senses.whyCN: 如果共同体要拥有，总得有人保管契据；国家是可用来保管的最大机构。

senses.title: The ballot-box road
senses.titleCN: 走投票箱的路
senses.definition: the version that seeks public ownership and equality through elections, parliaments and civil liberties rather than through a single-party seizure of power
senses.definitionCN: 通过选举、议会与公民自由、而非一党夺权来追求公有与平等的版本
senses.example: Democratic socialism ran candidates, won councils and kept the polling stations open.
senses.exampleCN: 民主社会主义推举候选人、赢下地方议会，并让投票站继续开门。
senses.why: The means shape the doctrine: if majorities must be persuaded each time, the ownership has to arrive with consent.
senses.whyCN: 手段塑造学说：若每次都必须说服多数，所有制就得随同意一同到来。

senses.title: The early experiment: a model community
senses.titleCN: 早期实验：样板共同体
senses.definition: the nineteenth-century strand that built small model settlements to show how shared property could work
senses.definitionCN: 十九世纪那一支：建立小型样板聚落，演示共享财产如何运作
senses.example: Utopian socialism built a model mill town and invited visitors to copy it.
senses.exampleCN: 空想社会主义建起一座样板工厂镇，并请来访者照它仿制。
senses.why: Before a theory can win a state it can win a village, so the earliest builders started at the scale of one settlement.
senses.whyCN: 理论在赢得国家之前可以先赢得一个村庄，因此最早的实践者从一个聚落的尺度开始。

senses.title: The claim to be a science
senses.titleCN: 自称科学的那一支
senses.definition: the strand that presents class conflict and historical change as laws to be analysed rather than ideals to be wished for
senses.definitionCN: 把阶级冲突与历史变迁当作可分析规律、而非可期盼理想的那一支
senses.example: Scientific socialism replaced sermons about justice with tables of wages and rents.
senses.exampleCN: 科学社会主义用工资与地租的表格取代了关于正义的说教。
senses.why: Calling a programme scientific is a move in an argument: it claims that the future is not a hope but a deduction.
senses.whyCN: 把一套纲领称作科学，是论辩中的一步棋：它声称未来不是希望，而是推论。

senses.title: The reformist neighbour
senses.titleCN: 改良主义的近邻
senses.definition: the variant that keeps markets and private firms but uses high taxes, unions and public services to narrow inequality
senses.definitionCN: 保留市场与私营企业、但用高税、工会与公共服务缩小不平等的变体
senses.example: The reformist wing of socialism settled for good pensions inside a market economy.
senses.exampleCN: 社会主义的改良一翼接受在市场经济内部提供优厚养老金。
senses.why: If the ownership cannot be changed yet, the same goal can be pursued through tax and service; the name stays close, the method does not.
senses.whyCN: 若所有制一时改不动，同一目标可以靠税收与服务去追；名字相近，方法却不同。

senses.title: The loose sneer
senses.titleCN: 松散的贬义用法
senses.definition: a hostile use of the word for any policy said to spend other people's money or to level down excellence
senses.definitionCN: 带敌意的用法：把任何被认为花别人钱、或把优秀拉平的政策都称作它
senses.example: The pamphlet used socialism to mean any tax he happened to dislike.
senses.exampleCN: 那本小册子把它当作任何他不喜欢的税的代称。
senses.why: A word that names a whole economic order is easy to stretch until it means nothing but disapproval.
senses.whyCN: 一个指称整套经济秩序的词，很容易被拉长到只剩「不赞成」的意思。

intro.en: The chain is short and well attested: Latin socius 'companion' gave socialis 'of companions, social'; French socialisme appeared in the early nineteenth century, and English socialists were already using the word in the eighteen-twenties.
intro.cn: 这条链既短又有据：拉丁语表示「同伴」的名词衍生出表示「同伴的、社会的」形容词；法语在十九世纪早期出现一套主张的名称，英语中的社会主义者在一八二〇年代已在用这个词。

items.en: Socius meant a companion or an ally, someone who shares a journey or a venture; it says nothing at all about property.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词意为同伴或盟友，即共同行路或共同经商的人；它对财产只字未提。

items.en: Socialis 'of companions, of association' described the bond rather than the state; English social and society both come from it.
items.cn: 这个拉丁形容词描述的是伙伴之间的联结，而非国家；英语中的「社会的」与「社会」两词都由它而来。

items.en: Societas named a partnership or an association, and it is the source of the English word for a company or an organised body.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指合伙关系或社团，是英语中表示公司或团体的词所由来。

items.en: French writers of the eighteen-twenties used socialisme for the new doctrine of association; the label was new and its edges were still loose.
items.cn: 十九世纪二十年代，法国作者用这个词称呼那套主张联合的新学说；标签是新的，边界也还松散。

items.en: The cooperative followers of Robert Owen in Britain adopted socialism in the eighteen-twenties; from there it entered ordinary political English.
items.cn: 英国欧文合作社的追随者在一八二〇年代采用了这个词；它由此进入日常政治英语。

items.en: After eighteen forty-eight the word was claimed by a specific programme of class struggle, and rival schools had to add an adjective to say which version they meant.
items.cn: 一八四八年以后，这个词被一套特定的阶级斗争纲领据为己有，竞争的各派不得不加上形容词，说明自己指的是哪一种。

note.en: The first group is built on the same root and is often mixed up with the headword; the second group is a set of neighbouring systems and arrangements.
note.cn: 第一组同出一根，常与词条混用；第二组是相邻的制度与安排。

entries.definition: The ordinary adjective for life among people, as in a social club or a social problem; it carries no programme and no ownership.
entries.definitionCN: 指人群之间生活的普通形容词，如社交俱乐部或社会问题；它不含纲领，也不含所有制。

entries.definition: A formal adjective meaning 'of society as a whole', used in sociology; it describes a level of analysis, not a doctrine.
entries.definitionCN: 正式形容词，意为「整个社会的」，用于社会学；它描述分析层次，而非学说。

entries.definition: A person who holds the doctrine, or an adjective describing a policy of that kind; the headword names the doctrine itself.
entries.definitionCN: 指持这套主张的人，或形容此类政策的形容词；词条指学说本身。

entries.definition: The study of societies and groups; it shares the root but names a science, not a political programme.
entries.definitionCN: 研究社会与群体的学科；它同根，但指一门科学，不是政治纲领。

entries.definition: A programme that aims at common ownership through the abolition of private capital and, in its revolutionary forms, of the market itself.
entries.definitionCN: 主张通过废除私人资本、并在其革命形式中废除市场本身来实现共同所有的纲领。

entries.definition: A movement that keeps markets and elections while using tax and services to narrow inequality; it is close to one wing of the headword.
entries.definitionCN: 在保留市场与选举的同时用税收与服务缩小不平等的运动；它与词条中的一支相近。

entries.definition: The principle that a group rather than an individual should own or decide; it can apply to a farm or a studio without any party.
entries.definitionCN: 主张由群体而非个人拥有或决定的原则；它可用于农场或工作室，无需任何党派。

entries.definition: The set of public services and transfers that soften market outcomes; it can exist inside economies that are not called by the headword.
entries.definitionCN: 指缓和市场结果的一整套公共服务与转移支付；它可以存在于并不使用这个词的经济体里。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin root, the real derived words and the real names of the schools.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实的派生词与真实的流派名称。

normal.en: The root means 'companion': joint ownership begins as an extension of sharing among companions.
normal.cn: 词根意为「同伴」：共同所有起初只是同伴之间共享的延伸。

normal.en: The family runs social, society, socialist, socialize and socialization.
normal.cn: 同族词包括社会的、社会、社会主义者、使社会化与社会化。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the schools: state socialism, democratic socialism, utopian socialism, scientific socialism.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出各流派：国家社会主义、民主社会主义、空想社会主义、科学社会主义。

normal.en: The suffix means 'doctrine': the name of a school, not of a single policy or a single person.
normal.cn: 那个后缀表示「主张」：它是学派名称，不是某项政策或某个人。

normal.en: History anchor: the word entered English through cooperative circles before it became a party label.
normal.cn: 历史锚点：这个词先经合作社团体进入英语，后来才成为党派标签。

abstract.en: A brass plate with the shareholders' names is unscrewed and replaced by a plate that says everyone.
abstract.cn: 写着股东名字的铜牌被卸下，换上一块写着「大家」的牌子。

abstract.en: Many hands on one wheel, and no single hand owning the wheel.
abstract.cn: 许多只手搭在同一个轮子上，却没有哪一只手拥有这个轮子。

abstract.en: A ledger of wages and rents kept open on a table, as if it could predict the future.
abstract.cn: 一本工资与地租的账册摊在桌上，仿佛能预测未来。

examples.en: Socialism would transfer the mines from private owners to the public.
examples.cn: 这种主张要把矿山从私人所有者转归公众。

examples.en: The party argued that socialism could arrive through the ballot rather than the barricade.
examples.cn: 该党主张，这套制度可以经由投票而非街垒到来。

examples.en: Critics used socialism as a label for any spending they disliked.
examples.cn: 批评者把它当作任何他们不喜欢的开支的标签。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「搜社利泽姆」——谐音「搜社」：把社会里的东西搜拢到大家手里 → 社会主义

root: 拉丁 socius「同伴」→ socialis「同伴的、社会的」→ 法语 socialisme → 英语本词；表示「主张」的名词后缀加在形容词之后。与表示「社会」的名词、表示「社会的」的形容词同族。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one claim on ownership: a system, a movement, a state version, a ballot-box version, an early model village, a claim to science, a reformist neighbour and finally a loose sneer.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一条所有权主张展开：制度、运动、国家版本、投票箱版本、早期样板村、自称科学、改良主义近邻，最后是松散的讥称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the deed to the mill is moved from private hands to a shared name.
core.cn: 核心意象：工厂的契据从私人手里移到大家名下。

branches.en: THEORY AND ITS FIRST EXPERIMENT: joint ownership as a principle, and the small settlement built to demonstrate it.
branches.cn: 理论与最初实验：作为原则的共同所有，以及为演示它而建起的小聚落。

branches.en: PRESSURE AND PROOF: the meetings and strikes that press the claim, and the attempt to dress it as a science.
branches.cn: 压力与证明：为这一主张施压的集会与罢工，以及把它装扮成科学的尝试。

branches.en: TWO WAYS TO HOLD THE DEED: the state as owner, and the reformist version that keeps markets and taxes instead.
branches.cn: 两种持有契据的方式：由国家充当所有者，以及保留市场、改用税收的改良版本。

branches.en: CONSENT: the road that requires majorities and polling stations.
branches.cn: 同意：需要多数与投票站的那条路。

branches.en: SNEAR: the word stretched until it means mere disapproval.
branches.cn: 讥称：这个词被拉长到只剩不赞成。

intro.en: The word is a Latin root, an adjective suffix and a doctrine suffix; the same pieces build a large family of everyday English words.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁词根、一个形容词后缀与一个表示主张的后缀构成；同样这些构件还构成一大族日常英语词。

latinIntro.en: Latin socius 'companion' supplies the root, -alis makes the adjective socialis, and -ismus names the doctrine; societas supplies the noun for an association.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁名词「同伴」提供词根，形容词后缀构成「同伴的、社会的」形容词，表示主张的后缀构成学说名称；其同源名词提供表示社团的名词。

items.meaningCN: 表示「同伴、结伴」的词根
items.example: The root pictures two people on one road.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根画出两个人走在同一条路上的画面。

items.meaningCN: 表示「属于……的」的形容词后缀
items.example: The suffix turns a companion into an adjective of association.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「同伴」变成表示结社的形容词。

items.meaningCN: 表示「体系、主张」的名词后缀
items.example: The suffix turns an adjective into the name of a school.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成学派名称。

items.meaningCN: 人们共同生活的；社会的
items.example: A social order rests on shared habits.
items.exampleCN: 一种社会秩序依赖共同的习惯。

items.meaningCN: 有组织的共同体
items.example: The society elected a committee.
items.exampleCN: 这个团体选出了一个委员会。

items.meaningCN: 喜欢与人相处的
items.example: She was sociable without being loud.
items.exampleCN: 她爱交往，却不喧闹。

items.meaningCN: 结伴；把……联系起来
items.example: Do not associate the two ideas too closely.
items.exampleCN: 不要把这两个想法联系得太紧。

items.meaningCN: 主张共同所有的学说
items.example: Socialism grew out of a critique of private mills.
items.exampleCN: 这套主张从对私营工厂的批评中长出。

items.meaningCN: 持这套主张的人
items.example: The socialist argued for public transport.
items.exampleCN: 这位社会主义者主张公共交通公有。

items.meaningCN: 使社会化；使归公
items.example: They socialized the water supply.
items.exampleCN: 他们把供水收归公有。

derivatives.zh: 社会主义者；社会主义的
